xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4292: Steer running Claude Code and Codex turns from the dashboard composer (Ctrl+Enter), not only Pi

plan.title: Steer running Claude Code and Codex turns from the dashboard composer (Ctrl+Enter), not only Pi
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The dashboard composer can steer a running turn only for Pi. To steer a Claude Code conversation or agent the operator must switch to the terminal. pan tell has no steer either.
narratives.Proposal: Add a submit mode ('enter' | 'steer') threaded through the terminal-backend prompt contract, the tmux paste path, the PTY supervisor and the Herdr adapter into deliverAgentMessage. Steer replaces the final Enter with Claude Code's send-now chord Ctrl+X Ctrl+S (bytes 18 13), which interrupts the running turn and sends immediately (verified live on tmux; bytes verified on Herdr). A HarnessBehavior.steerKind field gates the composer selector, Ctrl+Enter/Cmd+Enter, the conversation and agent routes, and pan tell --steer. Codex moves to sibling PAN-4303.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Codex steer (moved to PAN-4303; codex app-server 0.158 turn/start may already steer a busy turn and needs its own verification)
- A Follow-up / chat:queueSubmit (ctrl+x enter) option for Claude Code
- Steer for ACP, OpenCode, Kimi Code, Muse, Prime Agent, or remote (Fly) agents
- The Home composer (components/home/HomeComposer.tsx)
- Any change to Enter, Shift+Enter or default delivery behavior on any tier
- Upgrading already-running PTY supervisors; they report steerDegraded until the agent restarts
- Sending ctrl+enter / C-Enter on any backend
- Silently delivering a requested steer as a normal queued submit without telling the operator

autoDecisions.summary: Steer for Claude Code = chat:sendNow (interrupt the running turn and send now), labelled 'Steer' with a tooltip that says it interrupts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'the same way the TUI's Ctrl+Enter does'; Claude Code 2.1.280 binds ctrl+enter to chat:sendNow, whose changelog and a live probe both show it interrupts the turn.

autoDecisions.summary: Use the chord Ctrl+X Ctrl+S on every backend, never Ctrl+Enter.
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude Code binds ctrl+x ctrl+s to the same action; probes showed tmux 3.4 emits no bytes for C-Enter and Herdr 0.9.1 emits plain Enter (0d) for ctrl+enter, while ctrl+x ctrl+s arrives as 18 13 on both.

autoDecisions.summary: Split Codex into sibling issue PAN-4303.
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex uses the app-server transport, shares no code with the keystroke path, and its turn/start may already steer a busy turn per the 0.158 schema, so it needs its own verification-first plan.
One source that both the frontend and server already read via getHarnessBehavior, matching how other per-harness behavior is declared.

autoDecisions.summary: Ctrl+Enter/Cmd+Enter always sends deliverAs 'steer' on steer-capable harnesses, busy or idle.
autoDecisions.rationale: An idle send-now is a plain submit (verified), so this is safe and does not depend on a possibly stale agentBusy flag.

autoDecisions.summary: Claude Code selector offers Auto and Steer only; Pi keeps Auto/Steer/Follow-up.
autoDecisions.rationale: ctrl+x enter (chat:queueSubmit) was not verified, and the issue only asks to keep queue-after-turn, which Auto already does.

autoDecisions.summary: Steer never silently degrades: unsupported tiers return steer-unsupported, old supervisors report steerDegraded, unsupported harnesses get 422 / exit 1.
autoDecisions.rationale: An interrupt the operator asked for that silently turns into a queued message is worse than a visible refusal.

autoDecisions.summary: Herdr steer uses pane.send_text (bracketed paste) + settle + pane.send_keys instead of agent.prompt, with agent_blocked refusal.
autoDecisions.rationale: agent.prompt always ends with Enter; send_text writes raw bytes with no bracketed paste (probed), so explicit markers mirror tmux paste-buffer -p. Checkpoint with raw-text fallback.

autoDecisions.summary: pan tell --steer is refused for remote, non-Claude, paused, suspended and stopped targets, with nothing delivered or mailed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Steer has nothing to interrupt on a non-running agent and no transport on those harnesses; a clear refusal beats a surprising queue.

metadata.sizeJustification: One new parameter (submit mode) threaded through one delivery door: prompt contract, tmux, PTY supervisor, Herdr, deliverAgentMessage, the two message routes, messageAgent/pan tell, and the composer. Codex was already split out (PAN-4303). The subsystem count is inflated because each doc target (docs/*.md, configuration/*.mdx, sync-sources/skills) counts as its own subsystem under the lint heuristic; the code spans src/lib, src/dashboard, src/cli and packages/contracts.

items.title: Add HarnessBehavior.steerKind capability field

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In packages/contracts/src/harness-behavior.ts add `export type HarnessSteerKind = "send-now-keys" | "control-channel" | null` and `readonly steerKind: HarnessSteerKind` on HarnessBehavior. Set send-now-keys on CLAUDE_CODE_BEHAVIOR, control-channel on OHMYPI_BEHAVIOR, null on CODEX/ACP/KIMI_CODE/MUSE/PRIME_AGENT (OPENCODE inherits via spread). Add tests in harness-behavior.test.ts. Run `npm run build:contracts` before typecheck.

items.title: Given getHarnessBehavior('claude-code'), when steerKind is read, then it returns 'send-now-keys' (asserted in harness-behavior.test.ts).
Given getHarnessBehavior('ohmypi') and getHarnessBehavior('pi'), when steerKind is read, then each returns 'control-channel'.
Given getHarnessBehavior('codex'), 'acp', 'opencode', 'kimi-code', 'muse' and 'prime-agent', when steerKind is read, then each returns null.
Add steer chord module and tmux sendKeys submit mode

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/lib/terminal-backends/steer-keys.ts exporting SubmitMode, STEER_TMUX_KEYS ['C-x','C-s'], STEER_HERDR_KEYS ['ctrl+x','ctrl+s'], STEER_PTY_BYTES '\x18\x13', STEER_SETTLE_MS 300 and tmuxSubmitKeys(mode). Add `options?: { submit?: SubmitMode }` as the 4th parameter of sendKeys in src/lib/tmux.ts and use tmuxSubmitKeys(options?.submit) at BOTH `'send-keys', '-t', sessionName, 'C-m'` sites (first submit and the resend chaser). Add `readonly submit?: SubmitMode` to PromptOptions in src/lib/terminal-backends/types.ts and pass it from the tmux backend prompt() in src/lib/terminal-backends/tmux.ts. New test src/lib/__tests__/tmux-sendkeys-steer.test.ts modelled on tmux-dedup.test.ts, fake timers. Never send C-Enter (it emits no bytes through tmux 3.4).

items.title: Given sendKeys(session, text) with no options, when it submits, then it runs `send-keys -t <session> C-m` exactly as before.
Given sendKeys(session, text, caller, { submit: 'steer' }), when it submits, then it runs `send-keys -t <session> C-x C-s` and never C-m.
Given a steer paste whose text stays visible past the submit window, when the resend chaser fires, then it resends C-x C-s (fake timers drive the window).
Given the tmux backend prompt() called with options.submit 'steer', when it delivers, then sendKeys receives { submit: 'steer' }.
PTY supervisor writes the send-now chord for steer payloads

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. In src/lib/channels/pty-supervisor.ts add `submit?: 'enter' | 'steer'` to PtySupervisorPayload, validate it in parsePayload (other values → payload null → 400), write STEER_PTY_BYTES instead of '\r' at both child.write('\r') sites in injectPtyMessage when submit is 'steer', and answer writeJson(res, 200, { ok: true, submit: 'steer' }) on both keyed and unkeyed success paths for steer payloads (keep 'ok' otherwise). Tests in src/lib/channels/__tests__/pty-supervisor.test.ts with fake timers.

items.title: Given a payload with submit 'steer', when injectPtyMessage runs, then the fake PTY receives the content followed by '\x18\x13' and never '\r'.
Given a payload without submit, when injectPtyMessage runs, then the fake PTY still receives '\r' after the content.
Given a payload with submit 'x', when the server parses it, then it responds 400 and writes nothing to the PTY.
Given a successful steer injection, when the server responds, then the body is JSON {"ok":true,"submit":"steer"}; a non-steer success still returns 'ok'.
Herdr backend prompt() steer branch (send_text + ctrl+x ctrl+s)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 and decision D10. In HerdrBackend.prompt() (src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr.ts ~L764), after the checkPrompt verdict and before the agent.prompt call: when options.submit === 'steer', return unsupported if no agent pane id; return { refused: true, reason: 'agent_blocked' } when agent_status is 'blocked'; else call pane.send_text with the text wrapped in '\x1b[200~' … '\x1b[201~', await setTimeout(STEER_SETTLE_MS), then pane.send_keys with [...STEER_HERDR_KEYS]; return delivered. Never call agent.prompt for steer and never send 'ctrl+enter' (Herdr encodes it as plain Enter). Tests in tests/unit/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-adapter.test.ts with fake timers. The bracketed-paste choice is an implementation checkpoint settled in live-steer-verification.

items.title: Given prompt() with submit 'steer' on an idle or working agent, when it delivers, then the fake API receives pane.send_text (text wrapped in bracketed-paste markers) and then pane.send_keys ['ctrl+x','ctrl+s'], and never agent.prompt.
Given prompt() with submit 'steer' on an agent whose agent_status is 'blocked', when it runs, then it returns { refused: true, reason: 'agent_blocked' } and sends no input.
Given prompt() without submit, when it delivers, then it calls agent.prompt exactly as before.
Thread the submit mode through deliverAgentMessage and transcript confirmation

expected_outputs: deliver-agent-message, delivery and delivery-herdr-result tests pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 and decisions D8/D9. In src/lib/agents/delivery.ts: add `submit?: SubmitMode` to DeliverAgentMessageOptions and `steered?: boolean` to DeliveryResult; pass submit to herdrBackend.prompt; throw MessageDeliveryFailed when dedupKey and submit 'steer' are combined; app-server, ACP/Prime host and Channels tiers return { ok:false, failure:'steer-unsupported: <tier>' } for steer without posting; the supervisor tier adds submit:'steer' to the POST body only when steering and returns steered:false with failure 'supervisor predates steer; delivered as a normal submit' when the response body is not {ok:true,submit:'steer'}; all three tmux sendKeys sites pass { submit }. deliverMessageWithTranscriptConfirmation gains submit and forwards it, keeping the exact old call shape when absent. Tests in src/lib/__tests__/deliver-agent-message.test.ts.

items.title: Given submit 'steer' and a supervisor that answers {ok:true,submit:'steer'}, when deliverAgentMessage runs, then the POST body carries submit 'steer' and the result is { ok: true, path: 'supervisor', steered: true }.

Given submit 'steer' and a supervisor that answers the bare string 'ok', when deliverAgentMessage runs, then the result is ok:true with steered:false and failure 'supervisor predates steer; delivered as a normal submit'.
Given submit 'steer' routed to the Channels or app-server tier, when deliverAgentMessage runs, then it returns ok:false with failure starting 'steer-unsupported' and posts nothing.
Given submit 'steer' with a dedupKey, when deliverAgentMessage runs, then it throws MessageDeliveryFailed.
Given no submit option, when deliverAgentMessage and deliverMessageWithTranscriptConfirmation run, then every tier receives the same arguments as before (existing tests pass unchanged).
Conversation message route delivers deliverAs 'steer' for Claude Code

expected_outputs: the three conversation-message test files pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6 and decision D13. In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-message.ts, read body['deliverAs']; for non-Pi harnesses answer 422 { code: 'steer-unsupported' } (deliver nothing) when deliverAs is 'follow_up', or 'steer' on a harness whose steerKind is not 'send-now-keys'. For claude-code + 'steer', call deliver(..., { submit: 'steer' }) and add steerDegraded: delivery.failure to the JSON when delivery.steered === false. Pi routing (pickDeliverAs) is unchanged. Tests in src/lib/overdeck/__tests__/conversation-message-delivery-result.test.ts. Also add `submit?: SubmitMode` to EatenMessageWatchArgs in src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-eaten-message-watcher.ts, pass submit from the route when steering, and make the redelivery call pass { submit } as the 5th argument only when set (4-argument call otherwise), so a steer eaten by submit-time compaction is redelivered as a steer, never as a plain Enter.

items.title: Given a claude-code conversation and body deliverAs 'steer', when the route delivers, then the injected deliverAgentMessage receives { submit: 'steer' }.
Given a claude-code conversation and no deliverAs, when the route delivers, then deliverAgentMessage is called without a submit option.
Given a codex conversation and deliverAs 'steer', when the route runs, then it returns 422 with code 'steer-unsupported' and deliverAgentMessage is not called.
Given an ohmypi conversation and deliverAs 'steer', when the route runs, then the control channel receives type 'steer' as before.
Given a steer message eaten by submit-time compaction, when the eaten-message watcher redelivers it, then the redelivery passes { submit: 'steer' } to deliverAgentMessage.
messageAgent steer option with refusals and no idle wait

expected_outputs: messaging-steer, messaging-busy-agent-mail and messaging-conversation-harness tests pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7 and decisions D11/D12. Add `steer?: boolean` to MessageAgentRedriveOptions (src/lib/agents/agent-state.ts). In messageAgent (src/lib/agents/messaging.ts): when opts.steer, refuse with { delivered:false, queuedToMail:false, reason } and write no mail when the target harness steerKind is not 'send-now-keys', the agent is paused, suspended or stopped, or a remote state exists; skip waitForAgentIdle(normalizedId, 5000); keep ensureMainInputTarget; pass submit 'steer' to deliverMessageWithTranscriptConfirmation and the unkeyed deliverWithOptionalKey path; surface steered:false as the outcome reason. New test src/lib/agents/__tests__/messaging-steer.test.ts modelled on messaging-busy-agent-mail.test.ts.

items.title: Given a running claude-code agent and steer: true, when messageAgent runs, then waitForAgentIdle is not called and deliverMessageWithTranscriptConfirmation receives submit 'steer'.
Given a codex, kimi-code or ohmypi target and steer: true, when messageAgent runs, then it returns delivered:false with a reason naming the harness and writes no mail file.
Given a paused or stopped claude-code agent and steer: true, when messageAgent runs, then it returns delivered:false and does not resume the agent.
Given no steer option, when messageAgent runs, then the idle wait and delivery arguments are unchanged.
pan tell --steer flag and pan-tell skill section

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8. Add `.option('--steer', 'Interrupt the running turn and send now (Claude Code send-now; Ctrl+X Ctrl+S)')` to the tell command in src/cli/index.ts; add steer to TellOptions in src/cli/commands/tell.ts; refuse --steer for remote agents (exit 1 before sendToRemoteAgent); pass { steer: true } to messageAgent; print 'Message steered into <id>'s running turn' on success plus any degradation reason. Update sync-sources/skills/pan-tell/SKILL.md in the SAME commit with a 'Steer a running turn' section (scripts/lint-skills.sh compares it to pan tell --help). Tests in src/cli/commands/__tests__/tell.test.ts.

items.title: Given `pan tell --steer PAN-1 "msg"`, when tellCommand runs, then messageAgent receives { steer: true } in its options.
Given `pan tell PAN-1 "msg"` without the flag, when tellCommand runs, then messageAgent receives no steer option.
Given a remote agent and --steer, when tellCommand runs, then it exits 1 and sendToRemoteAgent is not called.
Given the built CLI, when `pan tell --help` runs, then it lists --steer and scripts/lint-skills.sh exits 0 against the updated SKILL.md.
Dashboard agent message route honors deliverAs 'steer'

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9 and decision D14. In src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/messaging.ts read deliverAs from the body in postAgentMessageLikeRoute, pass { steer: deliverAs === 'steer' } through handleAgentMessage → sendAgentMessage → messageAgent, and answer 422 { code: 'steer-unsupported', error: reason } when a steer is refused (delivered:false and not queued to mail). New test src/dashboard/server/routes/__tests__/agent-message-steer.test.ts (mock messageAgent as operator-interventions.test.ts does).

items.title: Given POST /api/agents/:id/message with deliverAs 'steer', when handled, then messageAgent is called with { steer: true }.
Given the same route without deliverAs, when handled, then messageAgent is called without a steer option.
Given messageAgent refuses the steer (delivered:false, queuedToMail:false), when handled, then the route responds 422 with code 'steer-unsupported'.
Composer delivery selector for every steer-capable harness

narrative.Action: PRD WI-10 and decisions D1/D6/D7. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ComposerFooter.tsx derive steerKind from getHarnessBehavior(harness) (@overdeck/contracts); render the existing deliveryMethodSelect when steerKind !== null and the session is alive, for conversations AND agents (drop the !agentId gate); options Auto + Steer, plus Follow-up only for 'control-channel'; Compact button stays Pi-only; replace the three `piConversation && deliverAs !== 'auto' ? deliverAs : undefined` expressions with an effectiveDeliverAs(override?) helper; Claude Code title uses the D1 tooltip text. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/composerSend.ts stop dropping deliverAs for agents. Tests in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/__tests__/ComposerFooter.test.tsx. Follow the pan-style-guide (reuse styles.deliveryMethodSelect).

items.title: Given a live claude-code conversation, when the composer renders, then the delivery select renders with exactly the options Auto and Steer.
Given a live ohmypi conversation, when the composer renders, then the select renders Auto, Steer and Follow-up as before.
Given a live codex conversation, when the composer renders, then no delivery select renders.
Given a claude-code agent session (agentId set) with Steer selected, when Enter submits, then the POST to /api/agents/<id>/message carries deliverAs 'steer'.
Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter in the composer sends as steer

narrative.Action: PRD WI-11 and decision D5. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ComposerPromptEditor.tsx widen onCommandKeyDown to (key: 'Enter' | 'SteerEnter') in InnerPluginProps and ComposerPromptEditorProps; in the KEY_ENTER_COMMAND handler keep Shift+Enter as newline and emit 'SteerEnter' when event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, else 'Enter'; update the header comment. In ComposerFooter.tsx give handleSubmit a deliverAsOverride parameter and make handleCommandKey('SteerEnter') submit with 'steer' when steerKind !== null (plain submit otherwise). Label the Steer option 'Steer (Ctrl+Enter)' or 'Steer (⌘+Enter)' on macOS. Tests in ComposerPromptEditor.test.tsx and ComposerFooter.test.tsx.

items.title: Given the editor, when ctrl+Enter or meta+Enter is pressed, then onCommandKeyDown receives 'SteerEnter'; plain Enter still yields 'Enter' and Shift+Enter still inserts a newline.
Given a claude-code conversation with the selector on Auto, when Ctrl+Enter is pressed, then the POST body carries deliverAs 'steer'.
Given a codex conversation, when Ctrl+Enter is pressed, then the POST body carries no deliverAs (same as Enter).

Verify steer end to end on live tmux and Herdr Claude Code panes

expected_outputs: the PRD contains the live verification log with tmux and Herdr excerpts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-13. After npm run build, use a throwaway probe script (scratch dir, not committed) against an isolated tmux socket (OVERDECK_TMUX_SOCKET_NAME=pan4292e2e) and an isolated Herdr session started with a clean env (env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH TERM=xterm-256color herdr session attach pan4292e2e inside a throwaway tmux pane; HERDR_SOCKET_PATH pointing at ~/.config/herdr/sessions/pan4292e2e/herdr.sock). Run claude --model haiku in each, make it busy with a Bash sleep, then deliver via sendKeys(..., { submit: 'steer' }) and HerdrBackend.prompt(..., { submit: 'steer' }); also a default (Enter) delivery and a two-line steer on Herdr. Read the probe JSONL to settle the transcript-landing checkpoint. Append a '## Live verification log' section with pane excerpts and the chosen Herdr text encoding to .pan/drafts/pan-4292.md. Tear down with literal paths; never touch the overdeck tmux socket or the operator's Herdr session. If the bracketed-paste markers render literally, switch herdr-steer-submit to raw text and record it.

items.title: Given a busy Claude Code pane on the isolated tmux socket, when a steer is delivered, then the captured pane shows 'Interrupted' followed by the steered message and a reply, recorded in the log.
Given a busy Claude Code pane in the isolated Herdr session, when a steer is delivered, then the captured pane shows 'Interrupted' followed by the steered message and a reply, recorded in the log.
Given a busy Claude Code pane, when a default (Enter) delivery is made, then the captured pane shows no 'Interrupted' line, recorded in the log.
Given the probe session's JSONL after a steer, when inspected, then the log states whether the steered user record is classified as a main-transcript landing.
